analogy.rationale: Local anesthetics block voltage-gated sodium channels (SCN5A/SCN1A/SCN10A), so sodium channel blockers and antiarrhythmics share the same primary target and downstream electrophysiological program. These cells are non-excitable, so the transcriptional response should be weak, with other ion-channel blockers as low-similarity neighbors.
